title.narrative: DG INTPA Helpdesk Service ContractTechnical Assistance Facility / Knowledge Hub for expertise on Anti-corruption

description.narrative: The overall objective of the action is to provide anti-corruption advisory services to staff at EU headquarters and EU delegations in third countries eligible for support under the NDICI Global Europe instrument, with a focus on Latin America and the Caribbean, Sub-Saharan Africa and Asia and the Pacific region. Strengthening the capacity of EU Headquarters and Delegations to identify, mitigate, and monitor corruption risks will help safeguard funds, ensure they reach intended beneficiaries, and reinforce the EU’s credibility as a global promoter of transparency, accountability, and good governance. As part of the contract, Transparency International will provide a package of advisory services, including information, evidence, insights and policy analysis through a range of formal and informal channels to EU HQ and delegation staff. These insights and data can, naturally, be used by EU staff to design and prepare projects, interventions and investments. Value of the contract is 1.6 million Euros

recipient-country.narrative: This project is managed by TI-S which is headquartered in Germany. The countries involved are spread globally.
